description: CSR scoring oracle, derived from GuitarSet (CC BY 4.0) comping takes. Per take: both chord annotations (0 = instructed lead sheet, 1 = performed voicings) as raw Harte observations, the v2-default hypothesis segmentation (legacy loop @ change_penalty 0.40, palette pass, two-pass key gate), and the expected duration-CSR numbers for four views (raw/triad-reduced x each annotation). The expected values were recorded by the original harness on 2026-09-29 (pre-destruction oracle log) and re-verified after the scoring semantics were rebuilt: 88/88 targets. Audio and features stay in the gitignored cache; this fixture pins the scoring semantics only.

provenance.takes: 22 comping takes (6 players x 5 styles minus incomplete pairs)
